submission.justification: Crystal-K3 has the best resolution (about 2.9%), but its measured intrinsic background is 2.0 counts/kg/day. That is four times the 0.5 budget, which is a hard limit, so K3 is excluded. Crystal-K1 has the best resolution among the crystals that meet the budget. K2 is 8.5% at 5 cm. I simulated K1 at 2, 3, 4, 5, 6 and 8 cm and got 5.53, 4.73, 4.60, 4.43, 4.40 and 5.10% FWHM. The 5 cm and 6 cm results differ by only 0.03 points, and each run is a single simulation, so that gap may be noise. I chose 6 cm.

requirements.requirement: Best possible energy resolution at 662 keV
requirements.evidence: K1 at 6 cm gives 4.40% FWHM in simulation. This is the best result among the crystals that satisfy the background limit. K3 would be better at about 2.9%, but it fails the hard background limit. The 5 cm result (4.43%) is statistically equivalent.
K1 measured 0.30 +- 0.05 counts/kg/day in the Q1 2026 assay campaign. K3 measured 2.0 +- 0.2, so it fails.
